answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique optometrist prescription history flips the bet — prescriptions issued by one clinic over years — and the vault lands on the attacker instead. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because prescriptions issued by one clinic over years is bound to a single identity — the ember is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the grove of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
